summary: Backend-only regression of CloudPay's provider-agnostic architecture. Ran full pytest suite (89/89 passed) and verified via live curl against http://localhost:8001 that: (1) only Mock provider is registered/exposed, (2) generic capability & health endpoints work with correct 404 for unknown providers, (3) live-mode provider creation is rejected, (4) generic public webhook contract reconciles by provider_txn_id and correctly flags unmatched/ignored, (5) payment engine posts succeeded mock (amount=1000 => net=1000, fee=0), fails decline (amount=113 => failed, net/fee 0), and idempotency replay returns same payment id, (6) auth-gated endpoints return 401 without token, (7) no Stripe/Razorpay code in core (only textual doc references remain in comments).

minor.issue: String literal 'stripe'/'Stripe' present in a comment/docstring only (no executable code). Task said 'payment_engine/webhooks contain no stripe string' — that is true; core payment_engine.py and webhooks.py are stripe-free. The remaining occurrences are illustrative comments in models/system/base. Consider removing or rewording for absolute cleanliness.

action_items: Optional: remove the illustrative 'stripe' word from comments in app/models/payment.py, app/routers/system.py, and app/providers/base.py to satisfy a strict grep-based cleanliness check.
critical_code_review_comments: Provider contract in app/providers/base.py is clean and provider-agnostic; Mock is the sole registered plugin.
Webhook endpoint POST /api/providers/{key}/webhook is correctly public (no auth) and returns {reconciled|unmatched|ignored} — matches spec.
Live-mode enforcement returns 400 with clear message; sandbox-only enforced at router.
Idempotency lock is claimed before dispatch; replay returns same payment id (verified live).
State transitions for succeeded->refunded validated via webhook path.
test_credentials: admin@cloudpay.io / Admin@12345 (from problem statement; login returns access_token via Set-Cookie header).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Existing 'acme' tenant used for live curl checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 89 backend tests pass with `cd /app/backend && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && python -m pytest tests/ -n0 -q`. MUST use -n0 due to known webhook xdist race. Payment POST requires 'reference' field in addition to tenant_id/provider_key/amount_minor/currency/idempotency_key. Auth via login Set-Cookie access_token used as Bearer. Only Mock provider registered — do not add Stripe/Razorpay unless architecture pivots again.
